_doc: Rifts fight back. Damage = base × waveBalance damageMultiplier (wave 1-100, day 1-365, difficulty) × phase × time of day × weather. Rift HP = defenseConfig portal HP × portalHpMultiplier × phase × days lasted; each Rift Sentinel has towers.hpShare of its rift's HP. Bases are tuned near a wave-1 Human Archer (20 dmg) so the rifts scale on the same curve as the invaders they guard.

scaling._doc: riftHp multiplies defenseConfig's portal HP (a rift with sentinels must hold ~10-20 s against a wave-1 General at ~50 DPS); phase / hpAtMaxDay add realm-phase and days-lasted toughness.

desc.en: A void whip that jumps between up to 3 nearby demons and beasts.
desc.tl: Latigong kawalan na tumatalon sa hanggang 3 kalapit na demonyo at halimaw.

desc.en: Mends the rift and its sentinels by 12% HP and halves the damage they take for 5 seconds.
desc.tl: Inaayos ang lagusan at mga bantay nito ng 12% HP at hinahati ang pinsalang natatamo sa loob ng 5 segundo.

desc.en: Once per wave, when the rift drops below 40% HP, it erupts: heavy damage to every demon and beast around it, flinging them back and slowing them for 4 seconds.
desc.tl: Minsan bawat alon, kapag bumaba sa 40% ang HP ng lagusan, sumasabog ito: malakas na pinsala sa lahat ng demonyo at halimaw sa paligid, itinutulak sila at pinababagal ng 4 na segundo.

desc.en: Two sentinel towers stand in every rift's 4×4 invasion zone and shoot at demons and beasts. Minions must topple them before they can strike the rift.
desc.tl: Dalawang toreng bantay ang nakatayo sa 4×4 na sona ng bawat lagusan at binabaril ang mga demonyo at halimaw. Kailangang pabagsakin muna sila bago matamaan ang lagusan.

environment._doc: Multipliers on top of the wave scaling. damage: all rift/sentinel hits; rate: attack speed (higher = faster); range: bolt/lash/sentinel reach; lashChains: extra Rift Lash jumps; wardHeal / wardSeconds: Warp Ward strength.

text.en: Rifts hit harder and faster at night (+20% damage, +15% attack speed, +10% reach) and a little softer by day. Rain lets Rift Lash jump to one more target for +25% damage but shortens their reach; snow slows their fire but strengthens Warp Ward; a heatwave adds 15% damage but the ward fades sooner.
text.tl: Mas malakas at mas mabilis ang mga lagusan sa gabi (+20% pinsala, +15% bilis ng atake, +10% abot) at medyo mahina sa araw. Sa ulan, tumatalon ang Latigo ng Lagusan sa isa pang kalaban na may +25% pinsala pero umiikli ang abot; sa niyebe, bumabagal ang atake pero lumalakas ang Kalasag ng Warp; sa matinding init, +15% pinsala pero mas maikli ang kalasag.

builders._doc: Between waves, human Technicians walk out of each dormant rift, hidden in its mist, to build missing Rift Sentinels, mend damaged ones and repair a smashed rift. Demons never target them. Sentinels persist between waves and are re-armed to full when the rift opens.

mist._doc: Fog over each 4x4 rift zone. Lifts while a wave is on, for revealSeconds when a scout comes through, and thins to peekDensity under the mouse. Returns when the reason ends.
